item.title: Football Australia Names Squad For Home Women's Asian Cup
item.description: Asian Cup Australia: Football Australia (FA) on Thursday named a 26-player squad for the AFC Women's Asian Cup Australia 2026. Head coach Joe Montemurro selected eight players set to feature at the tournament for the first time.

item.title: T20 WC: Zadran Dedicates Player of the Match Award to Departing Afghanistan Coach Trott
item.description: Ibrahim Zadran smashed a career-best 95* as Afghanistan defeated Canada by 82 runs in their final T20 World Cup Group D clash, with Mohammad Nabi’s 4-7 sealing the win and tributes pouring in for outgoing coach Jonathan Trott.

item.title: La Liga: Real Madrid Defend Their Top Spot As Barcelona Look To Improve Defense
item.description: Giovani Lo Celso: There is a new leader in La Liga for the 25th round of matches after Real Madrid overtook FC Barcelona last weekend, but Alvaro Arbeloa's side has a difficult away game on Saturday, travelling to Pamplona to face Osasuna at the hostile El Sadar stadium.

item.title: T20 World Cup: Devastated Australia ‘Zeroed In’ on Avoiding Oman Upset, Says Andrew McDonald
item.description: Australia coach Andrew McDonald admits his side is “devastated” after their T20 World Cup exit but insists they will stay focused and motivated to avoid an embarrassing defeat against Oman in their final group match.

item.title: Dortmund Secure Brazilian Teenager Prates On Long-term Deal
item.description: South American U17 Championship: Borussia Dortmund have completed the signing of Brazilian left-back Kaua Prates from Brazilian top-flight side Cruzeiro, with the 17-year-old set to join the Bundesliga club ahead of the 2026-27 season.

item.title: T20 WC: 'Fortunate Enough To Have Coached Some Great Players', Trott Ends Tenure As Afghanistan Coach
item.description: T20 World Cup: Afghanistan's final group game of the 2026 T20 World Cup, outgoing coach Jonathan Trott has reflected on his tenure with the side as he looks ahead to his next coaching opportunity.

item.title: Brazil, Egypt To Play World Cup FIFA WC Warmup Friendly In June
item.description: World Cup FIFA WC: Brazil to play Egypt in a friendly, a week before FIFA World Cup 2026 begins, in June as both teams finalise their preparations for the mega event, the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) said.

item.title: Knight Earns Maiden Call-up; Nensi Recalled To NZ Women Squad For Zimbabwe Series
item.description: U19 T20 World Cup: Uncapped duo Kayley Knight and Nensi Patel are in line to make their international debut after being named in the New Zealand Women squad for the white-ball series at home against Zimbabwe, NZC said on Friday.

item.title: Mensik Upsets Sinner In Doha, Sets SF With Fils
item.description: ATP Live Rankings: Jakub Mensik caused a major upset in the Qatar Open when the 20-year-old stunned World No. 2 Jannik Sinner in the quarterfinal of the ATP 500 event.

item.title: 'Leave The 22 Yards, Just Focus On Stumps': Shami's Valuable Advice For J&K; Bowlers For Ranji Trophy Final
item.description: KSCA Cricket Stadium: Experienced India fast bowler Mohammed Shami gave valuable advice to the Jammu and Kashmir bowlers for their maiden Ranji Trophy final in the history of the premier domestic tournament.
